lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters of varying diameter (larger posteriorly) arranged along the mid-to-lower flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows to form a coarse grid pattern visible in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance (top) to shadow (bottom).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately six discrete, high-luminance circular clusters distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, vertical linear feature of low pixel intensity is visible on the posterior flank near the base of the caudal region.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of micro-scale high-luminance points concentrated in the cephalic region anterior to the gill slits.
